$comment: Who may call every app/api/**/route.ts handler. Checked by scripts/check-authz.mjs (npm run check:authz): a route or method missing here fails, an entry for a route that no longer exists fails, and a method declared staff / service / server-key whose handler has no matching check fails. A method is a class string, or { class, note } when it needs a word of explanation. `risk` marks a known gap that is printed as a warning on every run until it is closed.

classes.anonymous: anyone on the internet — no key, no session id
classes.session: anyone holding the session id (the UUID in the seller's QR / SwapUp's camera link / CounterIQ's link); writes are judged by lib/sessionWriteRules.ts where it matters
classes.staff: a portal / Keycloak sign-in (portalUser / isEntAuthed / staffFor), tenant-scoped where the route says so
classes.service: a Keycloak client_credentials token (requireServiceToken) when KEYCLOAK_ISSUER is set; without it the route's shared secret or 503 (lib/m2m.ts)
classes.server-key: SwapUp's server via x-gradeiq-server-key (hasServerKey / paidCaller), or staff
